changelog: Interactive service selector modal for multi-mode jobs (Metro vs Freight) with mouse and keyboard shortcuts (1, 2, Esc).
Full GPS waypoint navigation (SetNewWaypoint) for all 9 jobs guiding players to depots, stops, fields, zones, and vehicles.
Glowing vertical 3D platform beam markers and floating arrival indicators for train stations.
Automatic vehicle entry warping on spawn for service trucks (garbage, tow, firefighter, trucker).
Added [GPS Depot] button in the /joblibre agency interface to replot the work route at any time.
Clarity pass: objective banner, per-job briefing (F7), plain-French HUD, world markers, reworked train controls, many job bug fixes.
Mission-style yellow route blip to the depot after signing; purple admin teleport blips on agency and depots.
